rationale: Establishes CI-enforced guards as hard blocks in the merge path for read-only and PII protection, and adds release machinery that gates all future changes to the tool surface.

signals.blast_radius: ~60 files of mostly inherited write tool deletions, plus 4 new files (two guards, allowlist, CI workflow); changes tool registry, test infrastructure, and build machinery
signals.unresolved: No design-changing uncertainties; all open questions have recommendations or are tuning-level with no impact on file list
signals.irreversibility: Fully git-revertible; write tool removal and guard addition break no existing dependencies since the server has no consumers yet
